description: ARGUMENT_ROLE_VOCABULARY_PREREG.md / _RESULTS.md: promotes the uppercase role placeholders inside RelationCue.relation ("[\"reduce\",\"UNCERTAINTY\",\"given\",\"PRIOR\"]") to a first-class, held ArgumentRole{name, gloss} node type -- the direct structural analogue of FunctionalRole (seeds/shape_vocabulary.json) one level down: FunctionalRole names system FUNCTIONS, ArgumentRole names argument SLOTS. RelationCue.relation itself is UNCHANGED (every downstream consumer -- _load_relation_cues, _relation_cue_index, _shared_shape, Rust shape_fit -- keeps reading the bare string, byte-identical); each RelationCue additionally carries real uses_role edges to the ArgumentRole(s) its relation tuple's uppercase tokens name, wired here STATICALLY from RELATION_CUE_TOKEN_COLLISION_RESULTS.md's own human-verified §3 classification (18 shared-intentional + 2 ambiguous + the 2 renamed-pair tokens + 2 fresh renamed-pair tokens + every unique-to-one-cue token, 65 ArgumentRoles total for the 52 RelationCues' full uppercase-token census). Two occurrences (attention_watch's NEW, source_recognition's CONTENT -- the vocabulary's own two AMBIGUOUS, never-confidently-classified tokens) are deliberately left UNWIRED here and wired instead by replaying them live through the mint-time guard below, as the real (not synthetic) disambiguation-needed demonstration. The MINT-TIME GUARD (RoleUseCheck productions + 3 rules) is the sd-loop-shaped recognize/mint/flag triad for any NEW RelationCue authored at runtime (domains/reflective_faculty.py::ground_predicate's teach() cue-minting path, or any future hand-authored teach(agent,'RelationCue',...) call): role_recognize_exact fires when the new cue's relation tuple is BYTE-IDENTICAL to an already-wired existing cue's (a pure keyword-synonym addition -- ground_predicate's own, only, current behaviour -- always safe, wired without friction); role_mint_fresh_token fires when an uppercase token has never been seen before (no ArgumentRole of that name exists yet -- safe by construction, mints a new ArgumentRole and wires it, mirroring seeds/blob_edge_correspondence.json's blob_mint exactly); role_flag_collision fires when the new cue reuses an EXISTING token under a STRUCTURALLY-DIFFERENT relation tuple -- the exact shape of the POSITION/PRIOR accident -- and files a SelfConcern{kind:'argument_role_collision'} instead of silently wiring the edge, mirroring seeds/gap_awareness.json's note_* gap-filing rules. 'add_edge targets must be match-bound vars in this engine' (sd_dedup_existing's own documented constraint, reused here rather than reinvented): role_recognize_exact only sets RoleUseCheck.status -- the ArgumentRole it recognizes is Term-found, not match-bound, so Python (check_new_relation_cue_roles, reflective_faculty.py, mirroring _resolve_blob_edge's exact pattern) re-resolves it by name and wires the uses_role edge AFTER run_rules(), executing the rule's own decision, never making one.

rules.name: role_recognize_exact
rules.comment: RECOGNIZE, sd-loop rung-1 shape: a pending RoleUseCheck (one per uppercase role token in a freshly-taught RelationCue's relation tuple -- written by domains/reflective_faculty.py::check_new_relation_cue_roles, the mechanical ingest step mirroring record_correspondence/blob_edge_correspondence.json's own pattern) whose owning cue's relation tuple is BYTE-IDENTICAL to an ALREADY-HELD other RelationCue's relation tuple is a pure keyword-synonym addition -- exactly ground_predicate's own, only, current live minting behaviour (it only ever reuses relation tuples already held verbatim). This is the ONE case the guard can be CONFIDENT is safe without any semantic judgement: identical structure, not merely an identical bare token. 'add_edge targets must be match-bound vars in this engine' (sd_dedup_existing's own documented constraint, reused rather than reinvented): the ArgumentRole this recognizes is Term-found (via the other cue's already-wired uses_role edges), not match-bound, so this rule sets STATUS ONLY -- Python (check_new_relation_cue_roles) re-resolves the ArgumentRole by name and wires RelationCue-uses_role->ArgumentRole AFTER run_rules(), executing the rule's own decision, never making one.

rules.name: role_mint_fresh_token
rules.comment: MINT, sd-loop rung-4 shape, mirroring seeds/blob_edge_correspondence.json's blob_mint exactly: a pending RoleUseCheck whose owning cue's relation tuple is NOT identical to any already-held cue (role_recognize_exact does not apply) AND whose token names NO existing ArgumentRole is a genuinely NEW role -- safe by construction, since there is nothing yet to collide with. Mints the ArgumentRole (a fresh node created in THIS rule's own effects, hence match-bound for the add_edge that follows -- the same 'blob' pattern blob_mint uses) and wires cue-uses_role->role directly, no Python re-resolve needed for this branch.

effects.gloss: (auto-minted at mint time by role_mint_fresh_token -- a genuinely new role token, no prior collision possible; no held gloss authored yet, needs human/agent review)

rules.name: role_flag_collision
rules.comment: FLAG, the honest residual terminal (mirrors seeds/gap_awareness.json's note_* gap-filing shape, and seeds/blob_edge_correspondence.json's blob_no_collapse terminal-status discipline): a pending RoleUseCheck whose owning cue's relation tuple is NOT identical to any already-held cue AND whose token DOES already name an existing ArgumentRole -- the token is being asked to do double duty in a structurally NEW context that has never been verified as the SAME sense (the exact shape of the confirmed POSITION/PRIOR accident: RELATION_CUE_TOKEN_COLLISION_RESULTS.md found this was NOT mechanically recoverable from structure alone -- genuinely-shared tokens like SELF also share almost no structure beyond the bare token). Rather than guessing, this files a SelfConcern (findable, human/agent-promotable, the SAME node shape gap_awareness's own rules mint) and leaves the uses_role edge UNWIRED -- 'flag it, don't silently install a second meaning under one name,' verbatim from the charter.
